## About this course

Many research studies in Nepal still collect data on paper and enter it manually into Excel or SPSS afterwards. This course shows you how to replace that process with **digital data collection**: you design your questionnaire once in an Excel file (an **XLSForm**), upload it to **KoboToolbox**, and collect data on a phone, tablet or web browser. [**Data arrive clean, coded and ready for analysis.**]{.highlight}

This **self-paced course** covers **basic to semi-advanced skills**. You can work through every module on this website and join the in-person session to practise together and build your own research questionnaire in XLSForm. You will then **upload it to KoboToolbox** to collect data.

::: {.callout-note}
## Who is this course for?
This course is for students, beginner researchers, survey tool developers, and anyone who wants to move from paper questionnaires to digital data collection. The examples use health-related data. No programming knowledge is needed; basic computer and Excel skills are enough.
:::

## Learning outcomes

By the end of this course, you will be able to:

1. Choose the correct question type (integer, decimal, single choice, multiple choice, date/time, text, note, etc.) for each research variable.
2. Explain the sheets of an XLSForm (`survey`, `choices`, and `settings`) and create an XLSForm with a bilingual (English and Nepali) setup.
3. Convert your own questionnaire into an XLSForm, including required questions, groups, skip logic, and constraints.
4. Create a KoboToolbox account, upload and deploy an XLSForm, and collect test data.
5. Download the KoboCollect app on a mobile device, link it to your KoboToolbox account, and use it to collect data offline and submit it to the server.
6. Build and edit a survey directly in the KoboToolbox Formbuilder.
7. Download collected data from the KoboToolbox server in Excel, CSV, or SPSS format for analysis.

## Before you start

- [ ] A laptop with Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc or Google Sheets
- [ ] A smartphone with internet access
- [ ] A KoboToolbox account (see [Module 5](05-kobo-account.qmd))
- [ ] The **KoboCollect** app installed on an Android phone (see [Module 7](07-kobocollect-mobile-app.qmd)). iPhone users can use the web form instead.
- [ ] A copy of your research/thesis questionnaire (Word or PDF)
- [ ] Download the course template: [msn_xlsform_template.xlsx](templates/msn_xlsform_template.xlsx), an example template to start your own form
